semantic_filter: Account entity key; one row per account.
aggregation_semantics: Count of distinct account identifiers.

validation.description: tab01.fld001 is the primary key of tab01 and is referenced by tab04, tab06, and tab08.

semantic_filter: Client entity key; one row per client.
aggregation_semantics: Count of distinct client identifiers.

validation.description: tab03.fld009 is the primary key of tab03 and is referenced by tab04.fld009.

semantic_filter: One disposition record per client-account relationship.
aggregation_semantics: Count of disposition records; count distinct accounts or clients as required.

validation.description: tab04.fld006 is the primary key; tab04.fld009 references clients and tab04.fld001 references accounts.

semantic_filter: District entity key; one row per district.
aggregation_semantics: Count of distinct districts.

validation.description: tab05.fld002 is the primary key and is referenced by tab01.fld002 and tab03.fld002; all references resolve.

semantic_filter: Loan entity key; one row per loan.
aggregation_semantics: Count of loans.

validation.description: tab06.fld027 is the primary key; tab06.fld001 references the account.

semantic_filter: Transaction entity key; one row per transaction.
aggregation_semantics: Count of transactions.

validation.description: tab08.fld036 is the primary key; tab08.fld001 references the account.

semantic_filter: Statement issuance frequency chosen for the account.
aggregation_semantics: Group accounts by the coded frequency value; count distinct accounts per value.

validation.description: Three observed codes with counts: POPLATEK MESICNE 4167, POPLATEK TYDNE 240, POPLATEK PO OBRATU 93.

semantic_filter: Date the account was opened. This fld004 is the account date, not the loan or transaction date.
aggregation_semantics: Compare or group by calendar year of the opening date.

validation.description: tab01.fld004 ranges 1993-01-01 to 1997-12-29; 1139 accounts open in 1993.

semantic_filter: Client gender code.
aggregation_semantics: Count distinct clients per gender code.

validation.description: Observed values: F 2645, M 2724.

semantic_filter: Client date of birth.
aggregation_semantics: Compare or group by date of birth or birth year.

semantic_filter: District name, not region.
aggregation_semantics: Group or list by district name.

validation.description: 77 districts have distinct names such as Hl.m. Praha, Benesov, Beroun.

semantic_filter: Region of the district, not the district name.
aggregation_semantics: Group districts and their accounts or clients by region.

validation.description: Eight distinct region values observed; each district has exactly one.

semantic_filter: District-level average salary attribute.
aggregation_semantics: Read the stored district value; do not sum it across accounts or clients. For grouped analysis, the district value is repeated at the entity level.

validation.description: 77 districts range from 8110 to 12541; all exceed 8000 and 8 exceed 10000.

semantic_filter: Date the loan was approved. This fld004 is the loan date, not the account opening or transaction date.
aggregation_semantics: Compare or group by calendar date or year of loan approval.

validation.description: tab06.fld004 ranges 1993-07-05 to 1998-12-08; 403 loans are approved between 1995-01-01 and 1997-12-31.

semantic_filter: Loan term measured in months.
aggregation_semantics: Compare individual loan durations; do not sum durations.

validation.description: tab06.fld029 ranges 12 to 60 months.

semantic_filter: Loan contract status code.
aggregation_semantics: Count loans or accounts per status code.

validation.description: Observed codes: A 203, B 31, C 403, D 45. Code C is documented as running and OK so far.

semantic_filter: Approved amount from the loan table only (tab06), not fld028 in tab07 or tab08.
aggregation_semantics: Compare, sum, or average approved loan amounts across loans.

validation.description: tab06.fld028 ranges 4980 to 590820 with mean about 151410.

semantic_filter: Operation kind of the transaction; VYBER denotes withdrawal in cash. NULL values are not operations.
aggregation_semantics: Count transactions by operation kind.

validation.description: Observed operation counts include VYBER 434918, VKLAD 156743, PREVOD NA UCET 208283, PREVOD Z UCTU 65226, VYBER KARTOU 8036, NULL 183114.

semantic_filter: Transaction direction type from tab08 only; fld007 in tab02 and tab04 has different domains.
aggregation_semantics: Count transactions per type value.

validation.description: tab08.fld007 values: PRIJEM 405083, VYDAJ 634571, VYBER 16666.

semantic_filter: Date the transaction was posted. This fld004 is the transaction date, not the account or loan date.
aggregation_semantics: Compare or group by transaction date.

semantic_filter: Transaction amount from tab08 only; the same column name in tab06 is the loan amount and in tab07 is the order amount.
aggregation_semantics: Sum or average transaction amounts across transactions.

validation.description: tab08.fld028 ranges 0 to 87400 with mean about 5924.

semantic_filter: Role of the client on the account: OWNER or DISPONENT.
aggregation_semantics: Count disposition records by role; filter accounts by whether the client is the OWNER.

validation.description: Observed roles: OWNER 4500, DISPONENT 869; each account has at most one OWNER.
